paragraphs: Abba bar Chanina: Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin, chapter 8, halakhah 4.
Rav Ada son of Rabbi Chanina: Nedarim 22b.
Rabbi Achi bar Chanina (a Tanna): Shabbat 79b.
Rabbi Assi bar Chanina: Bava Batra 56a.
Rabbi Gamliel son of Rabbi Chanina: Kohelet Rabbah 5:12.
Rabbi Chama bar Chanina: Berakhot 5b; Dikdukei Soferim there, at 32b, reads Rabbi Chiyya bar Chanina.
Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Chanina: Bava Kamma 39a.
Rabbi Yaakov bar Chanina (a Tanna): Shabbat 79b.
Rabbi Yirmeyah son of Rabbi Chanina: Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat, chapter 4, halakhah 1. Mareimar bar Chanina: Bava Metzia 97a. Rava bar Chanina: Shabbat 19b. Rabbah bar Chanina: Bava Batra 113b.
Rabbi Tanchum bar Chanina: Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 4, halakhah 4.

notes.text: The chapter/halakhah Eruvin, Shabbat and Berakhot locations are Jerusalem Talmud. All fourteen supplied list units, Rav/Rabbi titles, bar/son forms and Chama/Chiyya variants remain distinct; no target identities are bound.

The supplied fourteen list units collectively contain several patronymics, not one demonstrated father or one set of resolved identities. Berakhot 5b directly supplies Chama son of Chanina; exact DKS alternatives remain Hyman-attributed.
